t: A programmable smartwatch with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and a LoRa radio inside.
steps: Buy a T-Watch S3 from LILYGO or a maker store. Pick the LoRa band that is licence-free where you live.
Open the Meshtastic web flasher in Chrome or Edge and choose the T-Watch S3.
Flash the firmware and set your region in the Meshtastic phone app.
Send a test message to a friend with their own Meshtastic radio.
To code your own apps, install the Arduino IDE and add the ESP32 board package.
Install LilyGoLib from the Library Manager and upload the factory example.
meta: Open Board. From $45.89. A few stores.
